name: claude-use
stderr:
Usage: agent-shim [options] [command]

Run Claude Code under several logins from one machine, controlling what each one
shares with ~/.claude.

Options:
  -V, --version               output the version number
  -h, --help                  display help for command

Commands:
  identity                    Manage identities: each one is a separate Claude
                              Code login with its own credentials.
  profile                     Manage configuration profiles: named, reusable
                              rules for what an identity shares with ~/.claude.
  pool                        Manage pools: named sets of identities that a
                              launch picks one member of, by remaining quota or
                              the pool's listed order, with `claude
                              @pool:<name>`.
  job                         Manage jobs: prompts the front door runs
                              unattended as an identity, on a schedule or
                              shortly before a quota window resets to use quota
                              that would expire.
  provider                    Manage API providers: Anthropic-compatible
                              endpoints a launch can route through with
                              --provider.
  model                       Define and inspect the models the providers offer
                              and the virtual models chosen among them.
  rule                        Manage directory rules: pin an identity or
                              configuration profile to every launch under a
                              path.
  credential                  Manage the credentials identities authenticate
                              with.
  check [options] [path]      Show what a launch in a directory would share or
                              hide and why, plus credential and settings
                              diagnostics. Never touches the farm or spawns
                              claude.
  configure [options] [path]  Interactively toggle an identity's shared
                              categories, or the entries under one
                              ~/.claude-relative path, writing to whichever file
                              the 3-tier precedence selects.
  doctor [options]            Audit the whole ~/.agent-shim config graph: every
                              identity, every configuration profile's extends
                              chain, every provider, directory-rules.json,
                              config.json, categories.local.json,
                              active-identity, and real Claude Code binary
                              discoverability. Identity/directory-agnostic,
                              unlike `check`. Exits 1 when any check fails.
  shim                        Manage the `claude` command shim: an optional,
                              explicit way to also invoke this launcher as
                              `claude` instead of `agent-shim run`. Off by
                              default; every installer ships only `agent-shim`.
  statusline                  Serve as a statusline entrypoint: read the
                              client's stdin payload, add the identity's live
                              provider, account and usage windows under an
                              agent_shim key, then run the renderer named in
                              AGENT_SHIM_STATUSLINE_CMD or print the built-in
                              line.
  headroom                    Inspect the headroom routing daemon and choose
                              which sessions use it.
  codex                       Inspect the codex translation the front-door
                              daemon serves for codex providers.
  frontdoor                   Inspect the front-door daemon that routes every
                              agent-shim session.
  mcp [options]               Serve the front door's typed API as MCP tools on
